refresh_policy.rationale: Collection uses the owner's authenticated YouTube browser session. Login and session repair require the owner; lists are bounded browser snapshots.

public_listing.rationale: Browser replacement for seven Vana legacy YouTube scopes; live authenticated proof is required before promotion.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: Signed-in owner account identity from the account menu, plus channel fields when YouTube exposes an owner channel.

display.label: Your YouTube channel
display.detail: The owner channel ID, URL, title, handle and avatar when visible, plus the signed-in account email when visible.

id.description: Stable browser-observed owner identity: native channel ID when present, otherwise the owner channel URL or signed-in account email.

email.description: Signed-in Google account email, read from the avatar menu's Switch account header; omitted when the menu shows none.

channel_id.description: Native YouTube channel ID when exposed by the own-channel page.

streams.name: subscriptions
streams.description: Channels visible in the signed-in subscriptions page.

display.label: Your subscriptions
display.detail: Channel titles, links, badges and notification settings when the corresponding controls are visible.

subscriber_count_text.description: Browser-visible raw subscriber count for legacy projection; omitted when no count text is rendered.

streams.name: playlists
streams.description: Owner library playlists visible in the browser.

display.label: Your playlists
display.detail: Playlist titles, URLs and visible header metadata.

streams.name: playlist_items
streams.description: Videos visible in those playlists, up to 20 scroll rounds per playlist.

display.label: Your playlist items
display.detail: Video titles and URLs from each visible playlist. Scrolling is bounded.

duration_text.description: Browser-visible duration label for legacy projection.

streams.name: likes
streams.description: Videos visible in the signed-in Liked Videos (LL) playlist.

display.label: Your liked videos
display.detail: Liked video titles and URLs from the signed-in playlist. Scrolling is bounded.

duration_text.description: Browser-visible duration label for legacy projection.

streams.name: watch_later
streams.description: Videos visible in the signed-in Watch Later (WL) playlist.

display.label: Your watch later list
display.detail: Saved video titles and URLs from Watch Later. Scrolling is bounded.

duration_text.description: Browser-visible duration label for legacy projection.

streams.name: watch_history
streams.description: Observed history entries keyed by video and normalized viewing date, reconciled from the signed-in browser list. Scheduled runs stream bounded backfill batches and refresh the recent head; completion covers the observed traversal, while YouTube history can change between runs. Watch dates have day precision.

display.label: Your watch history
display.detail: Observed viewing dates are upserted by video and viewing date while history is traversed and the recent head is refreshed. A date is recorded when its section label can be resolved; no watch time is invented.

position.description: Current zero-based position on the observed browser history page, newest first; position can change when videos are re-watched or history changes.

watched_date.description: Day from the browser section header; null when unrecognized.

views_text.description: Browser-visible raw view count for legacy projection.

watched_date_label.description: Browser section header as shown at capture time.

reason_display_messages.inventory_not_proven_complete: YouTube did not provide enough source evidence to prove this list complete. Valid records were kept; the next run will try again
reason_display_messages.page_unreadable: The signed-in page did not expose a trustworthy record.
reason_display_messages.scope_not_supported: Watch history shows dates without watch times, so a time range cannot be applied to it.
reason_display_messages.youtube_profile_home_not_ready: The signed-in YouTube home page did not expose the account menu.
reason_display_messages.youtube_profile_account_header_unreadabl: The signed-in YouTube account menu did not finish loading.
reason_display_messages.youtube_profile_channel_link_unavailable: The YouTube account menu did not expose the owner's channel link.
reason_display_messages.youtube_profile_channel_page_unreadable: The owner's YouTube channel page did not expose a readable identity.
reason_display_messages.youtube_profile_about_page_unreadable: The owner's YouTube About page did not finish loading.
